title: 第二十章着震慑
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
王猛的呼吸顿时一滞，听见这话，就看见一张覆盖白光的拳头朝自己冲来。

    那张拳头在他眼中越来越大，越来越逼近。

    他下意识抬手格挡，挡在自己面前。

    “砰！”的一声，两者相撞。

    先是一阵疼痛，然后是一阵麻意自手臂开始蔓延，传遍全身。

    他倒吸一口凉气，快步后退，拉开了距离。

    他平稳了一下呼吸，瞅了眼自己拳上泛红的痕迹。

    这个家伙没看起来那么简单，自己刚刚那几拳，明明打在他身上了，他怎么一点事情都没有。

    他抬头看了看那个黑衣男子，好像隐约间看到了青色的东西。

    他揉了揉眼睛，这次看得更加清晰，也确定了心中的想法。

    那是他的锻体功法，自己刚刚那几拳连他的防御都没破开。

    不过再联想到对方的生面孔，他瞬间就猜出了对方的身份。

    那个今日要来报到的炉鼎。

    不过不是炉鼎吗，怎么可能有这般实力。

    他咬咬牙，索性不再留手，团团火焰覆盖在拳上，不断变化，最后化为两个雄狮，低沉地咆哮一声。

    但很快，雄狮就逐渐散去，只剩下手里的火焰。

    张守安自然知道，这是他功法没练够，只是浅浅学了一个表层，就来此张扬。

    王猛几步冲出，大步一跳，双拳在空中握在一起，狠狠砸向那个黑衣身影。

    他要让那人知道，我一个练气大成，可不是随便说说的。

    张守安反倒是丝毫不慌，始终站在原地，只是青光之下，出现了一抹金色。

    金刚锻体法。

    “砰！”王猛的拳砸在了张守安身前，只不过依旧如之前那般，他始终破不开张守安的防御，只能与里面的张守安面对面对峙。

    张守安面无表情，神色平淡。

    虽然自己的其他功法可能没多少，但就是锻体功法多啊。

    我这两招结合，可是能挡下筑基威压的。

    一拳……两拳……三拳。

    王猛发疯般，不信邪地接连攻击，但就是始终差那么一点。

    就那么一点。

    他不甘心地大喊道：“丁未，别愣着，过来帮我！”
content_en:
Wang Meng's breathing suddenly stagnated. When he heard these words, he saw a fist covered in white light rushing towards him.

The fist was getting bigger and bigger in his eyes, getting closer and closer.

He subconsciously raised his hand to block, blocking it in front of himself.

"Bang!" The two collided.

First there was a burst of pain, and then a numbness spread from his arm to his whole body.

He took a breath, stepped back quickly, and distanced himself.

He calmed his breathing and glanced at the red marks on his fists.

This guy is not as simple as he looks. The few punches he just hit were clearly on him, but he didn't do anything at all.

He looked up at the man in black and seemed to vaguely see something green.

He rubbed his eyes, seeing more clearly this time and confirming his thoughts.

That was his body-building technique, and the few punches he just punched didn't even break through his defense.

But when he thought about the other person's unfamiliar face, he instantly guessed the other person's identity.

The furnace tripod that will report for duty today.

But isn't it a furnace? How could it have such strength?

He gritted his teeth and simply stopped holding his hands. Balls of flames covered his fists, constantly changing, and finally turned into two lions, roaring in a low voice.

But soon, the lion gradually dispersed, leaving only the flame in his hand.

Zhang Shou'an naturally knew that this was because he had not practiced the technique enough and had only learned a superficial level, so he came here to show it off.

Wang Meng rushed out in a few steps, jumped in stride, clenched his fists in the air, and smashed hard at the black-clothed figure.

He wanted that person to know that I am a master of Qi training, and I don't just talk about it casually.

Zhang Shou'an, on the other hand, did not panic at all and always stood in place, but under the green light, a touch of gold appeared.

Diamond forging method.

"Bang!" Wang Meng's fist hit Zhang Shou'an in front of him, but it was still the same as before. He could not break through Zhang Shou'an's defense and could only confront Zhang Shou'an inside.

Zhang Shou'an's face was expressionless and his expression was dull.

Although I may not have many other skills, I have many body-building skills.

The combination of these two moves can block the pressure of foundation building.

One punch...two punches...three punches.

Wang Meng went crazy and attacked one after another unbelievingly, but he was always just a little short of the mark.

Just a little bit.

He shouted unwillingly: "Ding Wei, don't be stunned, come here and help me!"
